units.source_text: 且说明石道人既已完成夙愿，心中如释重负。

en.t: It is said that the Akashi monk, having fulfilled his long-cherished wish, felt as though a great weight had been lifted from his heart.

units.source_text: 翌日近午，源氏公子遣人送一封信到山边的内宅里。

en.t: Near noon the next day, Prince Genji sent a messenger with a letter to the inner rooms of the house by the mountain.

units.source_text: 从道人的话听来，这大概是个腼腆的姑娘，源氏公子心想：

en.t: Judging from what the monk had said, she was probably a shy young woman, Prince Genji thought:

units.source_text: 此种偏僻地方，或许隐藏着意外优秀的佳人，便悠然神往，

en.t: In such a remote place, there might be a surprisingly exceptional beauty hidden away, and his thoughts drifted toward her with quiet longing,

units.source_text: 在一张胡桃色的高丽纸上用心地写道：

en.t: so he carefully wrote the following on a sheet of walnut-colored Korean paper:
